meta.project: SharkTech — Novo Site Institucional do CEEP Curitiba

product_overview: SharkTech is a modern institutional portal for CEEP Curitiba that centralizes school information, course details, news, documents, and search in a responsive public website. It also includes a protected administrative area for managing approved content and student evaluations.
core_goals: Present institutional information about CEEP Curitiba in an organized public portal.
Let visitors browse course offerings and inspect detailed course information.
Enable site-wide search across courses, news, and documents.
Provide a public evaluation submission flow for course feedback or testimonials.
Protect administrative access with login and allow authorized content management in a dashboard.

features.name: Institutional navigation
features.description: Allows visitors to move through the public institutional pages using the site’s shared navigation structure.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the home page -> Open an institutional information page -> Return to the home page -> Open the admissions information page -> Open the contact page
Navigate to / -> Use responsive navigation controls -> Open the courses catalog -> Open the news page -> Open the documents page

features.name: Course catalog and filters
features.description: Displays the available courses and lets visitors narrow the list by search term, technological area, and shift.
user_flows: Navigate to /cursos.html -> View the course list -> Enter a course search term -> Select a technological area filter -> Select a shift filter -> Review the filtered results
Navigate to /cursos.html -> View the course list -> Open a course detail page
Navigate to /cursos.html -> Enter a search term -> Review matching courses -> Clear or adjust the filters -> Review the updated course list

features.name: Course details
features.description: Shows complete information for a selected course, including curriculum, requirements, graduate profile, teachers, and approved evaluations.
user_flows: Navigate to /cursos.html -> Open a course detail page -> Read course description and curriculum -> Review entry requirements -> Review graduate profile -> Review approved evaluations
Navigate to /cursos.html -> Open a course detail page -> Read course information -> Return to the course catalog

features.name: Course comparison
features.description: Lets visitors compare two courses side by side and review their differences.
user_flows: Navigate to /comparador.html -> Select a first course -> Select a second course -> Compare the selected courses -> Review the differences
Navigate to /comparador.html -> Select two courses -> Compare the selected courses -> Review the comparison results

features.name: Site search
features.description: Searches across courses, news, documents, and other published site content.
user_flows: Navigate to /busca.html?q=:query -> Enter a search query -> Submit the search -> Review the matching results -> Open a matching result
Navigate to /busca.html?q=:query -> Enter a different search query -> Submit the search -> Review the updated results

features.name: News and documents
features.description: Provides public access to published institutional news, announcements, documents, and notices.
user_flows: Navigate to /noticias.html -> Browse published news -> Open a news item
Navigate to /documentos.html -> Browse published documents -> Open a document or notice
Navigate to /noticias.html -> Review the latest publications -> Open the documents page -> Review published documents

features.name: Student evaluation submission
features.description: Allows users to submit a course evaluation or alumni testimonial for moderation.
user_flows: Navigate to /area-do-aluno.html -> Choose evaluation or testimonial type -> Fill in the evaluation form -> Submit the form -> See submission feedback
Navigate to /area-do-aluno.html -> Fill in the evaluation form with missing or invalid required information -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Administrator authentication
features.description: Lets administrators sign in to the protected dashboard and sign out after finishing their work.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/index.html -> Fill in administrator email -> Fill in administrator password -> Submit login credentials -> Access the administration dashboard
Navigate to /admin/index.html -> Fill in invalid administrator credentials -> Submit login credentials -> See authentication errors
Navigate to /admin/painel.html -> Log out from the dashboard -> Return to the administrator login page

features.name: Administration content management
features.description: Provides authenticated administrators with tools to review, approve, reject, create, edit, and delete managed content.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/painel.html -> View dashboard data -> Review pending evaluations -> Approve or reject evaluations -> Save the changes
Navigate to /admin/painel.html -> View dashboard data -> Create or edit news and documents when controls are available -> Save the changes
Navigate to /admin/painel.html -> View dashboard data -> Delete managed content when controls are available -> Confirm the removal

known_limitations.issue: MySQL is required for course, content, search, evaluation, and administration data flows
known_limitations.impact: Those flows cannot be fully validated when the database is unavailable or empty

known_limitations.issue: Administrator credentials are created separately by the criar-admin script
known_limitations.impact: Login tests require a seeded administrator account and must not assume credentials from source control

known_limitations.issue: The site uses static HTML pages with client-side JavaScript rather than a frontend framework
known_limitations.impact: Some route transitions and data rendering depend on asynchronous API requests after page load
